candidateObjectiveEnglish: Name cleanup tools and gloves, describe two workers’ tool use and produce a glove reminder and old-nail removal phrase.
grammarExplanationEnglish: An imperative uses the base verb without a subject: "Put on your gloves." In "Pull all the old nails", "all the" precedes a plural noun. It can also precede an uncountable noun in other contexts. "One worker uses the shovel and another uses the wheelbarrow" describes two people and their tools.
grammarExplanationFrench: L’impératif emploie le verbe de base sans sujet : « Put on your gloves ». Dans « Pull all the old nails », « all the » précède un nom pluriel ; un nom indénombrable est possible ailleurs. « One worker uses the shovel and another uses the wheelbarrow » décrit deux personnes et leurs outils.
